_help: Prompts for tools/assets/generate_audio.py. sfx: prompt, seconds (0.5 to 30), loop (ambiences), influence (0 to 1, default 0.5). music: prompt, seconds. Examples taken from River Cleaner: India (05/11/2026), replace them with the game's own. Method: docs/recettes/sons-et-musique.md.

pickup.prompt: Quick grab of a light plastic bottle, short soft plastic crinkle, close-up, dry studio, no reverb, no music

throw.prompt: Fast short whoosh of an object thrown through the air, single swish, dry, no music

ui_click.prompt: Loud crisp single mouse click, sharp wooden tock, button press, clearly audible, instant attack

walk_grass.prompt: Field recording of a person walking slowly on a grassy meadow, about six natural footsteps on soft grass and earth, sandals, realistic foley, outdoor, no music, no voices

ambience_river.prompt: Calm river ambience, gentle flowing water and soft lapping on the bank, outdoor, continuous, no voices, no music

chai_beats.prompt: Indian lo-fi hip hop instrumental, 85 BPM, dusty boom bap drums with vinyl crackle, mellow Rhodes piano chords, a chopped sitar sample loop, deep warm bass, laid-back and cosy, study beats vibe, no vocals
